lanes.name: python
lanes.description: Data pipeline: signals, backtests, on-chain store, evidence, spot flow, page contracts. One test serves the site locally on 127.0.0.1.
lanes.command: rm -f .coverage && python3 -m coverage run --branch --source=scripts -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -q && python3 -m coverage json -q -o coverage/python.json

lanes.name: node
lanes.description: Browser-side models (observatory, positioning radar), the ticker relay and the Binance relay handler.
lanes.command: mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude='tests/**' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/node.lcov tests/observatory-model.test.cjs tests/ticker.test.cjs tests/positioning-radar.test.cjs tests/relay.test.mjs tests/distribution-radar.test.mjs
